blocks.template_raw:
{{Dialogue|&e[NPC] Beth&f: I... I had no idea this was here. What could Jake be hiding in this secret part of the lab?
&e[NPC] Beth&f: It's very dark in here, where's the light-switch in this place?
&e[NPC] Beth&f: Oh... my... what is all of this?
&e[NPC] Beth&f: &fThis is... this isn't just about plushies anymore. Jake's been working on something much bigger.
&e[NPC] Beth&f: Hybridization? &cMutation&f? What is this madness? He's experimenting on something...
&e[NPC] Beth&f: Resilient livestock... enhanced growth rates... Jake, what have you done?
&e[NPC] Beth&f: &fThese aren't normal &acrops&f. These are &cmutated&f... just like the ones we've been finding in the Garden. But why hide all of this down here?
&8&oA door opens from within the lab, and Jake shows up
&e[NPC] Jake&f: Beth... I told you to stay out of this.

&e[NPC] Beth&f: Jake! You have a lot of explaining to do, once again... What is all of this? What are you doing down here?
&e[NPC] Beth&f: Please tell me the truth this time Jake, I can't take all these lies anymore!

&e[NPC] Jake&f: &fIt's... it's not what it looks like. This lab... it's for research. To improve farming techniques, to help both &acrops &fand &eanimals &fadapt to new environments.

&e[NPC] Beth&f: &bResearch&f? This doesn't look like research, Jake! This looks like you are playing with life itself. Those tanks, those animals, what are you actually doing to them?

&e[NPC] Jake&f: &fYou don't understand, Beth! Farming as we know is evolving. If we don't adapt, we'll be left behind. The world's demands are growing, and so are the challenges.

&e[NPC] Beth&f: &fThat doesn't give you the right to hide this from everyone. What about the risks? The ethics?
&e[NPC] Beth&f: &fYou're creating something entirely unnatural.

&e[NPC] Jake&f: &f&osigh &fI know it seems... wrong. But these experiments could change everything.
&e[NPC] Jake&f: &fImagine crops that can survive the harshest conditions, or animals that never get sick.
&e[NPC] Jake&f: &fIt's not just about survival, it's about thriving.

&e[NPC] Beth&f: &fAnd what about the things you are not telling me? What else are you hiding down here, Jake?

&e[NPC] Jake&f: &fThere are some things you're better off not knowing. Not yet at least.

&e[NPC] Beth&f: &fNo, Jake. I've come this far, and I won't stop now. If you won't tell me the truth, I'll find it myself.

&e[NPC] Jake&f: &fBeth, you don't understand, some things aren't ready to be uncovered. It's not about keeping secrets, it's about protecting what I've been working towards.

&e[NPC] Beth&f: &fProtecting what? Your pride? Your experiments? This isn't just about you, Jake. We have a responsibility to use this lab for good, not to bury it under layers of secrecy.
&e[NPC] Beth&f: &fWhat's this?

&e[NPC] Jake&f: &fThat... is the &aCrop Analyzer&f.

&e[NPC] Beth&f: &fThe &aCrop Analyzer&f? What does it do?

&e[NPC] Jake&f: &fIt's a tool I've been developing. It analyzes &cmutations &fin crops, helps identify traits that can improve &6yield&f, &9resistance &for even &dflavor&f.
&e[NPC] Jake&f: &fBut it's not finished. It's delicate work, Beth. Work that requires precision, and data.

&e[NPC] Beth&f: &fWork that shouldn't be done in isolation. Jake, this could change everything for farmers everywhere. Why are you hiding something so revolutionary?

&e[NPC] Jake&f: &fBecause it's not perfect yet. A mistake could have disastrous consequences. I didn't want to involve anyone until I was sure it was ready.

&e[NPC] Beth&f: &fJake, you've done incredible work here. But you don't have to do it alone anymore. Let me and &7<player> &fhelp you.
&e[NPC] Beth&f: &fTogether, we can finish this and make sure it's used responsibly.

&e[NPC] Jake&f: &fAlright. You're right, Beth. I've been trying to carry this burden alone for too long. If we're going to make this work, we'll do it together.
&e[NPC] Jake&f: &fAnd you, &7<player>&f, you've been instrumental in getting us to this point. You should have access to the &aCrop Analyzer&f. You've earned my trust.
}}

blocks.template_raw:
{{Dialogue|&e[NPC] Beth&f: I... I had no idea this was here. What could Jake be hiding in this secret part of the lab?
&e[NPC] Beth&f: It's very dark in here, where's the light-switch in this place?
&e[NPC] Beth&f: Oh... my... what is all of this?
&e[NPC] Beth&f: &fThis is... this isn't just about plushies anymore. Jake's been working on something much bigger.
&e[NPC] Beth&f: Hybridization? &cMutation&f? What is this madness? He's experimenting on something...
&e[NPC] Beth&f: Resilient livestock... enhanced growth rates... Jake, what have you done?
&e[NPC] Beth&f: &fThese aren't normal &acrops&f. These are &cmutated&f... just like the ones we've been finding in the Garden. But why hide all of this down here?
&8&oA door opens from within the lab, and Jake shows up
&e[NPC] Jake&f: Beth... I told you to stay out of this.

&e[NPC] Beth&f: Jake! You have a lot of explaining to do, once again... What is all of this? What are you doing down here?
&e[NPC] Beth&f: Please tell me the truth this time Jake, I can't take all these lies anymore!

&e[NPC] Jake&f: &fIt's... it's not what it looks like. This lab... it's for research. To improve farming techniques, to help both &acrops &fand &eanimals &fadapt to new environments.

&e[NPC] Beth&f: &bResearch&f? This doesn't look like research, Jake! This looks like you are playing with life itself. Those tanks, those animals, what are you actually doing to them?

&e[NPC] Jake&f: &fYou don't understand, Beth! Farming as we know is evolving. If we don't adapt, we'll be left behind. The world's demands are growing, and so are the challenges.

&e[NPC] Beth&f: &fThat doesn't give you the right to hide this from everyone. What about the risks? The ethics?
&e[NPC] Beth&f: &fYou're creating something entirely unnatural.

&e[NPC] Jake&f: &f&osigh &fI know it seems... wrong. But these experiments could change everything.
&e[NPC] Jake&f: &fImagine crops that can survive the harshest conditions, or animals that never get sick.
&e[NPC] Jake&f: &fIt's not just about survival, it's about thriving.

&e[NPC] Beth&f: &fAnd what about the things you are not telling me? What else are you hiding down here, Jake?

&e[NPC] Jake&f: &fThere are some things you're better off not knowing. Not yet at least.

&e[NPC] Beth&f: &fNo, Jake. I've come this far, and I won't stop now. If you won't tell me the truth, I'll find it myself.

&e[NPC] Jake&f: &fBeth, you don't understand, some things aren't ready to be uncovered. It's not about keeping secrets, it's about protecting what I've been working towards.

&e[NPC] Beth&f: &fProtecting what? Your pride? Your experiments? This isn't just about you, Jake. We have a responsibility to use this lab for good, not to bury it under layers of secrecy.
&e[NPC] Beth&f: &fWhat's this?

&e[NPC] Jake&f: &fThat... is the &aCrop Analyzer&f.

&e[NPC] Beth&f: &fThe &aCrop Analyzer&f? What does it do?

&e[NPC] Jake&f: &fIt's a tool I've been developing. It analyzes &cmutations &fin crops, helps identify traits that can improve &6yield&f, &9resistance &for even &dflavor&f.
&e[NPC] Jake&f: &fBut it's not finished. It's delicate work, Beth. Work that requires precision, and data.

&e[NPC] Beth&f: &fWork that shouldn't be done in isolation. Jake, this could change everything for farmers everywhere. Why are you hiding something so revolutionary?

&e[NPC] Jake&f: &fBecause it's not perfect yet. A mistake could have disastrous consequences. I didn't want to involve anyone until I was sure it was ready.

&e[NPC] Beth&f: &fJake, you've done incredible work here. But you don't have to do it alone anymore. Let me and &7<player> &fhelp you.
&e[NPC] Beth&f: &fTogether, we can finish this and make sure it's used responsibly.

&e[NPC] Jake&f: &fAlright. You're right, Beth. I've been trying to carry this burden alone for too long. If we're going to make this work, we'll do it together.
&e[NPC] Jake&f: &fAnd you, &7<player>&f, you've been instrumental in getting us to this point. You should have access to the &aCrop Analyzer&f. You've earned my trust.
}}
